selection.method: top KCg-m_L cells by descending raw KC-to-MBON11_L contact count; all connected ALPN_L inputs retained
selection.selection_bias: Enriches KCs strongly connected to MBON11 and is not a random or complete KC population.
selection.pn_scope_note: ALPN is a source-native anatomical class. It includes projection-neuron types whose sensory modality and transmitter/sign are not resolved by the two extracted source tables; it must not be read as a guarantee of purely olfactory, cholinergic input.
